segments.text: Thank you, Senator Johnson, and thank everybody for sharing their stories.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I know it cannot be easy to do so.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My firm of over 20 professionals has represented individuals injured by vaccines for many years, and so we're very familiar with these heartbreaking stories, and I empathize with every one of you.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: While we've been doing, while we've been representing people for vaccine injury for quite a while,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It wasn't until the COVID-19 vaccine that our phones, emails, form submissions have reached an avalanche of submissions.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If we could actually sue the pharmaceutical companies for all those injuries, it would actually be humanly impossible for my firm, or I think the collective efforts of all attorneys around the country that handle vaccine injury cases, which are about 100 attorneys right now, to handle all of those matters.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: As things stand right now, you can't sue Pfizer, J&J, or Moderna for any of the injuries.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You can't bring a claim in the Vaccine Injury Compensation Program either.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: you are relegated to a program called CICP, which has a standard of proof that makes it almost impossible to obtain compensation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And even if you do prevail, the amount of compensation is, is, um, is, is de minimis for the most part.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Among the folks that have contacted our firm are many physicians from across the country who themselves have suffered vaccine injuries.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I've spoken to many of them, and while their stories vary, their injuries vary, there are three common themes that they all convey.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The first one is that, and we heard a lot of you express the same tear today, is that after they suffered an injury, they went to the very medical establishment that they work in.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: to go and get treatment.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And even though they themselves were physicians, the initial reaction they often got was one of, we don't believe you.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Often they were told it was psychological, referred to counseling, instead of treating the injuries that were being presented.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And these are physicians.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: A lot of times they had to go and go to physicians that they went to medical school with or who they had worked with, those colleagues who would believe them.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The other common theme is that they, for the most part, report that they submitted a VAERS report that they had to do it and often their physicians didn't.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: and that after submitting the VAERS reports, like many of you, they expected a phone call that never came.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And a lot of them explain how they then would take the initiative to directly contact the CDC or the FDA or public health authorities themselves.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And again, it was either silence or after
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: an exchange of some nature, the end result was typically the same.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Don't worry.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Theirs is not seeing this safety problem, so it's not an issue.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Nothing to see here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Your issue is not an issue because it's not an issue in theirs.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: One of the things that I often ask physicians who contact the firm is, will you publicly, will you make public the failing of our public health agencies?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And that's often has the same reaction as well.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And that is one of immense fear.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The fear of retaliation from public health officials and the medical establishment, if they come forward with even their own story of their own injury is palpable.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: No physician agreed to go forward until, as you pointed out, Senator, Dr. Patricia Lee, who herself was not injured by a vaccine, but as a matter of conscience, she simply could no longer sit idly by after seeing a series of extraordinarily serious injuries after COVID vaccinations.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: She did what every other physician
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Should do.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: She reported those series of cases to VAERS.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: She was expecting that somebody would contact her.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And nobody did.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And not just any cases.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: A young woman who's pregnant became paraplegic, lived just long enough to have her baby and die a month later.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Two other young women who lost most of their small intestines.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: incredibly devastating injuries.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: She waited for the call that never came.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: This letter right here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: She sent it on September 22, 2021.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's publicly available.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You can read what she sent them.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: She waited one day, two days, seven days,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: No response.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: On the eighth day, my firm sent the letter asking the FDA and CDC, are you really going to ignore this mainstream pediatrician trained at Harvard and Georgetown Medical Centers who is telling you about serious injuries from this product?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They did respond to her eventually, and they even actually had a meeting with her.

segments.text: And what did they tell her?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Exactly.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That's exactly what she got.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The silence that you hear.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Until eventually, Dr. Marks did begin to speak and explain to her, VAERS is a wonderful system and we're not seeing safety signals.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The act of bravery by Dr. Patricia Lee resulted
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And in this letter, we attach 11 declarations from physicians detailing similar catastrophic injuries from COVID-19 vaccines, as detailed by Dr. Lee.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's right here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You can find it.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Everything's fine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: VAERS says it's safe.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: despite not being able to work anymore, despite they themselves being catastrophically injured, still would not put their names out publicly.

segments.text: Their declarations have their names and their identities redacted, because even though they can't even engage in their normal medical practice, they still have that palpable fear of retaliation from the medical profession and from public health authorities.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: For those who did put their names out there, hopefully it will encourage other physicians.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And that snowball will hopefully lead to recognition.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And that is what is the first step to addressing the injuries everybody's described here today.

segments.text: Until public health authorities acknowledge these injuries, you can't seek treatment.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
